items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer lists Earl Hines as part of the bill at an event Dave Liebman attended, but Liebman does not mention any personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship with Hines.

ctx.x: Oh God. I can’t believe walking in on that.

Half the audience walked. But the bill that night, just to be quick about it – I don’t want to hog your time – but the bill that night was Earl Hines, Carmen McRae, Stan Getz’s quartet with Gary Burton, Steve Swallow, and probably Roy Haynes, Coltrane’s quartet, and the [Duke] Ellington band.
It definitely stood out like a sore thumb.
